name: Care For The Sick
overview: Scripture teaches that caring for the sick is a vital expression of Christian love and obedience, as believers are called to bear one another's infirmities rather than seeking self-pleasure (Romans 15:1). The Lord Himself heals and restores, as seen in Psalms where God heals both physical and emotional wounds (Psalms 30:2; 147:3). Jesus commands His followers to freely give healing and deliverance as they have received it (Matthew 10:8), and He identifies acts of kindness toward the suffering as service done unto Him personally (Matthew 25:40). This underscores the sacred responsibility to minister to those in need with Christlike compassion.
